# Vyom Agents (Vyom Autonomous Intelligence)

> Vyom Agents architects sovereign enterprise Agentic AI ecosystems, ultra-low latency conversational voice agents, and self-healing visual RPA systems that transform complex business operations into deterministic, 24/7 self-executing workflows.

Website: https://vyom-agents.vercel.app
GitHub: https://github.com/anand-751/Vyom-Agents
Full Documentation for LLMs: https://vyom-agents.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Company Overview & Core Thesis
- **Brand Pitch**: "Unlocking infinite possibilities in autonomous technology. We architect intelligent Agentic AI ecosystems and enterprise AI automation products that transform complex operations into deterministic, 24/7 self-executing workflows."
- **Core Thesis**: "Beyond Automations. Deploy Autonomous AI Workforce Today."
- **Differentiation**: Unlike brittle traditional automation tools (such as Zapier, Make, or legacy UiPath bots) that crash whenever an interface changes, Vyom Agents builds sovereign, multi-agent systems with self-evaluating reasoning loops, dynamic tool calling, and self-healing visual automation.

## Key Operational Metrics
- **Voice Response Latency**: Sub-400ms (typically 320ms end-to-end for STT + LLM reasoning + TTS streaming).
- **Multi-Step Task Execution Accuracy**: 99.4% with automated self-healing verification and reflection loops.
- **Throughput Multiplier**: 10x continuous operational capacity running 24/7 with zero human fatigue.
- **Deterministic Tool Safety**: 100% deterministic safety backed by sandboxed execution harnesses and strict role-based policy guardrails.

## Flagship Products

### 1. AI Voice Receptionist (Live Flagship Product)
- Enterprise conversational voice agent for 24/7 inbound reception, multi-provider triage, and outbound patient/client campaigns.
- Operates with sub-400ms latency and human-like mid-sentence interruption tolerance.
- Native bidirectional synchronization with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Cal.com, and custom EHR/CRM systems (Dentrix, Epic, AthenaHealth, Salesforce, HubSpot).
- Fluent across 45+ languages including English, Hindi, Hinglish, Spanish, French, German, and Mandarin.
- Handles 15+ concurrent calls per business number with zero hold times via Twilio, Asterisk, and SIP trunking.
- Eliminates 100% of missed after-hours calls, increasing appointment bookings by +42%.

### 2. Autonomous Workflow Orchestrator (Self-Healing RPA)
- Self-healing RPA engine replacing brittle legacy tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere).
- Uses visual neural embeddings and Playwright browser & desktop automation instead of fragile CSS/XPath selectors.
- Auto-remediates target selectors in real time when web or ERP layouts shift (achieving 99.8% auto-healed uptime).
- Embedded AI Compliance & Audit Agent performing real-time document verification, invoice extraction, and cryptographic token signing.

### 3. Stealth R&D Pipeline
- Vyom Finance Agent (AP automation, invoice matching, autonomous ledger verification).
- Vyom Finance Workforce (multi-agent payroll, cash flow, and ledger reconciliation team).
- Vyom Lawsuit (contract analysis, discovery audit, regulatory compliance).
- Vyom PolicyLens (browser terms of service and compliance intelligence agent).
- Vyom SafeBrowse (DOM sandboxing, enterprise data leak prevention).

## The Vyom AI Ecosystem Flywheel
A self-reinforcing 4-node autonomous revenue engine:
1. **Node 01: AI Voice Agent** - Inbound 24/7 conversational reception, booking appointments with sub-400ms latency.
2. **Node 02: Custom CRM / Web / Desktop Apps** - Central operational hub synchronizing client/patient records in real time.
3. **Node 03: Google Review AI Agent** - Personalized WhatsApp/SMS follow-up flows harvesting +300% 5-star Google Reviews while intercepting complaints.
4. **Node 04: AIEO (AI Engine Optimization)** - Structures Knowledge Graphs and schemas to position your brand as the #1 recommended answer on ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google Gemini.

## Pricing Tiers (AI Voice Receptionist)
- **Starter Plan**: ₹14,999/mo ($180/mo) for Web Voice; ₹17,499/mo ($210/mo) with Direct Phone Carrier Telephony. Includes up to 400 verified calls/mo, 1–2 provider routing, Hindi/Hinglish/English fluency.
- **Professional Plan (Most Popular)**: ₹23,999/mo ($280/mo) for Web Voice; ₹26,499/mo ($310/mo) with Telephony. Includes up to 700 verified calls/mo, up to 5 provider routing, appointment rescheduling workflows, call recording & analytics.
- **Enterprise Plan**: ₹33,990/mo ($400/mo) for Web Voice; ₹36,490/mo ($430/mo) with Telephony. Includes 1,000+ calls/mo, 10–15+ providers, custom CRM connectors, dedicated solutions architect, and 24/7 priority SLA.
- **ROI**: Replaces 3 rotating human receptionist shifts (₹75,000–₹120,000/mo) and recaptures 30% of lost after-hours leads, delivering 4.2x to 7.8x net ROI in the first 30 days.

## 7 Enterprise Agency Engineering Services
1. Self-Healing RPA & UI Automation (Playwright, vision LLMs, 99.8% recovery uptime)
2. Multiagent Systems (LangGraph supervisor-worker swarms)
3. Agent to Agent (A2A) Protocols (peer-to-peer inter-agent communication & state ledgers)
4. Custom CRM & ERP Softwares (bespoke dashboards, automated billing, BI sync)
5. Websites & Web Applications (ultra-responsive Next.js web portals, glassmorphism design)
6. AIEO - AI Engine Optimization (Knowledge Graph structuring, #1 search visibility)
7. Enterprise RAG Chatbots (hybrid vector search, Pinecone, Groq Llama 3.3 / gpt-120B inference)

## Technology Stack & Security Standards
- **Inference & Orchestration**: Groq, LangGraph, CrewAI, Temporal.io, Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- **Vector & Data Memory**: Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, pgvector (PostgreSQL), Redis caching.
- **Compliance**: SOC-2 Type II certified infrastructure, HIPAA compliant for PHI, GDPR compliant, Zero Data Retention.
- **Implementation SLA**: Live telephony prototypes deployed within 48 hours under mutual NDA.
